terms.label: Rest edge
terms.unit: per day more rest than the other side

terms.label: Travel edge
terms.unit: per 1,000 miles less travel since its last game

terms.label: Pitcher edge
terms.unit: per run a 9 innings its starter allows fewer than the other

terms.label: Time zones from home
terms.unit: per time zone the other side sits east of its own home clock (west negative), less its own

terms.label: Time zones crossed
terms.unit: per time zone the other side has flown east since its last game (west negative), less its own

terms.label: Late by its clock
terms.unit: per hour the start falls past 9 PM by the other side's own home clock, less its own

terms.label: Early by its clock
terms.unit: per hour the start falls before noon by the other side's own home clock, less its own

terms.label: Off a blowout win
terms.unit: when the other side won its last game by a blowout, less its own

terms.label: Off a blowout loss
terms.unit: when the other side lost its last game by a blowout, less its own

terms.label: Long road trip
terms.unit: when the away side is on its fourth road game or more in a row

terms.label: Home stand opener
terms.unit: when the home side is back from a trip (its first home game after it)

terms.label: Tired bullpen
terms.unit: per 30 pitches more the other side's top three relievers threw in the last three days, less its own

terms.label: Plate umpire (home lean)
terms.unit: per point (run, goal) a game the home side has beaten the teams' own margins with this crew

terms.label: Last season's OPS
terms.unit: per .100 better OPS last season

terms.label: Last season's ERA
terms.unit: per run lower ERA last season

terms.label: Last season's fielding
terms.unit: per 10 fielding runs more last season

terms.label: Platoon edge
terms.unit: per whole lineup more with the platoon edge on the other side's starter

terms.label: Pitchers (total)
terms.unit: to the total per run a 9 innings both starters allow under average

terms.label: Temperature
terms.unit: to the total per 10°F over 70°F (outdoors)

terms.label: Wind out
terms.unit: to the total per 10 mph blowing out toward center (in: negative)

terms.label: Rain
terms.unit: to the total when it's raining at first pitch (StatsAPI's report; a coming game without one posted is none, and flagged when rain is forecast)

terms.label: Off a blowout win (total)
terms.unit: to the total per side coming off a blowout win

terms.label: Thin air
terms.unit: to the total per 1% thinner air than average (warm, humid, high up; outdoors)

terms.label: Tired bullpens (total)
terms.unit: to the total per 30 pitches both sides' top three relievers threw in the last three days

terms.label: Plate umpire (total)
terms.unit: per point (run, goal) a game its crew has run over what the teams usually score

terms.label: Plate umpire (zone)
terms.unit: per strikeout a 9 innings more than average its plate umpire's zone gives the starters

terms.label: Umpire zone x strikeout pitchers
terms.unit: per strikeout a 9 innings of his zone's lean times the starters' strikeouts over average

terms.label: Last season's OPS (total)
terms.unit: to the total per .100 of both sides' OPS over average

terms.label: Last season's ERA (total)
terms.unit: to the total per run of both sides' ERA over average

terms.label: Last season's park factor
terms.unit: to the total per 10 points of the home park's run factor over 100

terms.label: Platoon edges (total)
terms.unit: to the total per whole lineup with the platoon edge, both sides, over 55%

terms.label: Ballparks by hand
terms.unit: per whole lineup more lefties (against the starter faced) than the other side, at each park (31 parks; most: Citizens Bank Park +1.1, Oracle Park +1.1, Coors Field +0.91)

terms.label: Ballparks by hand (total)
terms.unit: to the total per whole lineup of lefties on both sides over 40%, at each park (31 parks; most: Nationals Park +1.1, PNC Park +1.1, American Family Field +0.96)

terms.label: Ballparks
terms.unit: to the total at each park (31 parks; most: Yankee Stadium 0, Rogers Centre 0, Globe Life Field 0)
